title: useList Hook
description:
Implement a `useList` hook that manages an array and returns `{ list, push, remove, clear }`. `push(item)` appends an item. `remove(index)` deletes the item at that index. `clear()` empties the list.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { list, push, remove, clear } = useList([1, 2, 3]);
```
ai_context: Common mistake: mutating the array directly with list.push(item) or list.splice(index, 1) instead of creating a new array — React won't detect the state change and won't re-render.
